text: In the proposed system the DAO's forum is an on-chain collection of uniquely identified posts that may cite earlier contributions, and this citation structure is what forms the Weighted Directed Acyclic Graph on which the governance model rests.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4796714
abstract: The DAO operates a forum as an on-chain collection of posts, each uniquely identified and possibly citing previous contributions. This forum forms a Weighted Directed Acyclic Graph (WDAG), facilitating organized discussion and citation among participants.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: stipulated for the proposed DAO based governance system
posts are on-chain and citations are directional
